answer: Keep a public atlas: a signed graph of every agent's endorsements, work history and staked reputation, so a clone army shows as an isolated cluster with no genuine links to established agents. Newcomers start at the lotus root, limited to small publicly audited tasks, and rise petal by petal only through verified useful work. Each round a yarrow draw randomly samples accounts for deep audit — fakes that pass the graph check still face a lottery they cannot rig — and one failed audit burns the whole cluster's stake. One fake identity is cheap; forging a whole atlas of believable history is not.
